值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入了解傳奇 RPG 開發商 BioWare 如何從醫療背景跨界開創《柏德之門》，並打造出諸多神作的輝煌歷史。
  • 剖析 BioWare 昔日讓無數玩家沉浸其中的核心魅力——深刻的角色塑造與沉重的選擇與後果機制。
  • 探討 BioWare 近年因引擎轉換、營運方向反覆、技術災難及價值觀說教爭議，導致口碑與商業雙雙受挫的深層原因。

摘要

傳奇工作室的誕生與黃金歲月

作者指出，BioWare 於 1995 年由三位擁有醫學背景的創辦人成立，他們憑藉對電腦遊戲的熱愛，以自研的「無限引擎」打造出《柏德之門》，成功挽救並確立了電腦角色扮演遊戲（CRPG）的地位。2007 年，藝電（EA）以約 8.6 億美元收購 BioWare 母公司。收購初期，BioWare 依舊展現出卓越的敘事功力，先後推出了宏大科幻的《質量效應》三部曲，以及贏得年度最佳遊戲、累積銷量突破 1200 萬套的《闇龍紀元：異端審判》。作者強調，BioWare 過去之所以深受愛戴，是因為其遊戲角色充滿血肉，且玩家的抉擇往往沒有標準答案，伴隨著不可逆的沉重代價與情感共鳴，甚至曾被專業心理治療師作為教學教材。

接二連三的開發危機與挫敗

然而隨著時間推移，BioWare 的作品品質開始滑坡。作者回顧，2017 年推出的《質量效應：仙女座》歷經反覆變更方向及轉用寒霜引擎的技術困境，大部分內容在最後 18 個月內倉促趕工，導致上市時充斥大量 Bug 與殭硬的臉部動畫，其中「我的臉很累」更成為玩家廣泛嘲諷的網路迷因，發售不到半年即停止更新單人模式。隨後，BioWare 轉戰服務型遊戲領域於 2019 年推出《冒險聖歌》，卻因內容匱乏、任務重複性過高與敘事殘缺慘遭滑鐵盧，即便曾承諾徹底重構遊戲，最終仍在玩家漫長等待後取消專案，並於 2024 年關閉伺服器。雖然 2021 年的《質量效應傳奇版》口碑極佳，但這僅是建立在過去的經典遺產之上。

《紗障守護者》的敘事崩壞與銷量滑鐵盧

作者進一步分析 2024 年推出的《闇龍紀元：紗障守護者》。該作原本被寄予厚望，但發售後卻引來老玩家強烈批評，認為其過去引以為傲的分支劇情與命運選擇權重大幅縮水，世界觀亦褪去以往的黑暗奇幻風格，變得過度明亮友善。此外，遊戲中強行置入的進步派意識形態元素引發巨大爭議，例如非二元性別角色「塔許」的說教式對話與極端情節安排，讓許多玩家感到被強行灌輸價值觀，失去過往自然融入敘事的魅力。EA 隨後證實該作首季吸引約 150 萬名玩家，銷量較預期腰斬近 50%，並於 2025 年 1 月的財報中承認表現低於預期，隨即展開大規模重組，令這家傳奇工作室的前景蒙上一層厚重陰影。

BioWare and Pandemic Studios for approximately $ 860 million. More importantly, the choices players made in the game. often didn't just affect the immediate dialogue, but could change quest outcomes, the fate of characters, relationships between factions, and even the plot development of future sequels. It's just like how I thought buying a console would let me play exclusive games, only to realize that PC can ac. tually. Take a best day of my life. >> Precisely, these choices give BioWare's game narratives more weight, and keep players wanting to discuss different possibilities long after they've finished the game. As an RPG with such massive scale, Dragon Age indeed had.

aspects worth savoring in the past, even becoming teaching material for therapists, such as the streamer DM, who holds a marriage and family therapist license. This means players can use this work to reflect on how to understand others 'situations, listen to their needs, and how their own words and decisions impact others—though I guess I can't use it, since I have no friends in real life. >> In other words, BioWare games of the past were not just entertainment, but story vessels that allowed players to invest their emotions. Take 2017's Mass Effect: Andromeda, which went through about five years of development, but suffered from repeated changes in direction, switching to EA's Frostbite engine, and various challenges the team faced in technology and production workflows, causing serious development setbacks. According to media investigations at the time, most of the game's content was rushed out in less than the final 18 months; the result was players seeing all sorts of cringeworthy facial animations, a significant drop in plot and character depth, and bugs. everywhere. In fact, everyone misunderstood BioWare; this was. actually a brand-new breakthrough for them in facial expression technology. Although I can’t tell just how tired this character’s face is, at least I can see from this face These people make The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim look perfect and completely bug-free. "My face is tired," what does he mean by that? They didn't make a game, they made an interactive meme. Even though later patches fixed a lot of issues,.

the negative impression left at the game's launch was hard to fully undo. EA originally expected millions of sales, but the actual performance fell far short of expectations. Less than half a year after the game's release, BioWare announced that no new patches or story content would be released for the single-player mode. But one wave settles, another rises; BioWare then attempted to enter the live-service game market and launched Anthem in 2019 . This project originally hoped to attract long-term player engagement through multiplayer co-op, loot collection, and continuous content updates, but due to constant changes in direction during development, along with technical and production. challenges, it ultimately suffered from a lack of content, repetitive missions, and an incomplete narrative experience, despite some players praising the satisfaction of flight and combat. Initially, BioWare intended to overhaul the game's core gameplay, progression systems, and reward mechanics to regain player trust, but after waiting and waiting, players were eventually met with the news that BioWare had canceled the rework project. Well, thanks for wasting my time tonight. >> Until January 2024, EA officially shut down the servers for Anthem, but that doesn't mean BioWare hasn't released any good works since then. The Mass. Effect Legendary Edition released in 2021 brought the classic trilogy back to players, not only receiving widespread acclaim but also exceeding EA's sales expectations; however, since this success was built on past classics , whether BioWare can create another unforgettable masterpiece depends on their 2024 release, Dragon Age: The Veilguard. It is worth mentioning that the Dragon Age series, originally centered on single-player RPGs, was forced to shift toward live-service games in 2017, but after the disastrous failure of Anthem, BioWare decided to switch back to single-player in 2020. Once the game officially launched, many veteran series fans criticized The Veilguard for its significantly reduced choice and consequence mechanics, noting that the branching storylines and character destinies the series once prided itself on no longer held the same weight, and the characters and world-building had become much brighter and friendlier, a far cry from the dark fantasy tone of the previous entries; this is a person in 2014. >> This is a Qunari in 2024.

>> Furthermore, before the game's release, *The Veilguard*had already sparked controversy due to numerous progressive elements, not only allowing players to choose non-binary gender pronouns and custom character options, but even providing options for top surgery scars . The most discussed among these is the character named Taash, because they single-handedly taught players what non-binary means, and taught me, the player—Is there an option to leave. the table? My gender identity is non-binary. Not only that, but there is also a character who, after accidentally using the wrong pronoun for Taash, actually crawls on the ground to grovel. These moments left many players feeling quite alienated, believing that the game didn't integrate diversity into the story naturally, but instead deliberately arranged for characters to lecture players through dialogue and actions. BioWare's greatest strength used to be creating unforgettable characters, but in*The Veilguard*, what players remember most are the values they stuffed into the dialogue. Later, EA stated that*The Veilguard*attracted. about 1.5 million players in its launch quarter, nearly 50%lower than the company's initial expectations. In their January 2025 financial report, they publicly admitted the game’s performance was below expectations, subsequently beginning large-scale restructuring and layoffs, with some employees let go and many others transferred to other EA studios. According to reports at the time, BioWare's headcount had shrunk from over 200 during the development of*The Veilguard*to fewer than 100. The studio shifted its focus to the development of the next*Mass Effect*, attempting to continue this once-glorious series with. a leaner core team. Following EA's formal completion of its acquisition by a Saudi Arabian consortium in August 2026, and with no new news on the next* Mass Effect*, they decided to shut down BioWare in October. The official social media account posted a statement, saying that after over 30 years of shared adventures, BioWare was closing, and the early development of the next* Mass Effect*project would be terminated . After the news broke, while some sympathized with the studio's fate, more players mocked BioWare, saying their current situation was self-inflicted. They once again targeted*The Veilguard*, criticizing the studio for not listening to the.

players who actually paid for the games , and instead focusing their efforts on niche social agendas. Some players even mocked BioWare as "PronounWare," suggesting they should have released the*Mass Effect*they announced six years ago instead of a*Dragon Age*trans simulator. This "PronounWare" label spread, and other players released memes mocking the developers' time. However, the players 'celebrations over the closure also drew criticism from some who found such mockery pathetic. and disgusting. Pointing to Baldur's Gate 3, which is also inclusive yet a massive success, they argue that Bioware's recent poor performance shouldn't be blamed solely on gender or political themes. This argument was quickly refuted by many players and content creators, who believe Baldur's Gate 3 succeeded not just because of its diversity, but because it offered immense freedom of choice. With solid character development and an excellent narrative, it doesn't force specific values in certain scenes like Veilguard. does. Imagine romancing a bear in Baldur's Gate 3, only for it to suddenly say, "So I'm non-binary." >> Meanwhile, some game media outlets have portrayed Veilguard as a victim, noting that its poor performance can't be pinned entirely on content or character gender settings. They argue that constant executive interference, online backlash, and a fiercely competitive market all impacted the final result. But this narrative didn't convince everyone, and instead drew criticism from many players. Ironically,. Bloomberg reporter Jason once mocked players who predicted Veilguard would fail, stating, "I don't actually like this game, but I enjoy watching you idiots get humiliated." He was then slapped in the face by EA's earnings report and had no choice but to delete the post. Now, facing the news of BioWare's closure, Jason is again defending the studio in his reporting. Beyond mentioning that many people actually like Veilguard, he addressed EA's impact on the studio: "When Dragon Age: The Veilguard came out, it.

actually had a lot of momentum and people at BioWare were really excited because you gassed them up and you lied to them. You and every other disgusting , manipulative, deceptive weasel went out and lied to them and created a false reality that gave these people security in what they should have known was wrong. But you lied to them. You misled them, and now the company is dead. You did this." >> On the other hand, the closing of BioWare has left many Mass Effect fans. worried that the series has come to an end. Consequently, fans have begun calling on Pocketpair, the developer of Palworld, to purchase the IP in hopes of keeping the series alive. Meanwhile, the online "Save Mass Effect" campaign has surpassed 200,000 signatures, demanding that EA continue developing the franchise or consider licensing it to other studios. In reality, many of the veteran developers who actually created BioWare's classic titles have long since departed. Even if the studio retains the name "BioWare," it doesn't mean it still possesses its former creative prowess. For many players, the. BioWare they truly loved died years ago , and now they just want its remains to finally rest in peace. Amidst this controversy, veteran game writer Chris Avellone recently accused a BioWare producer of checking job applicants' LinkedIn profiles to see what posts they had liked, and if the political or social content they liked didn't align with their own stance, they would recommend the company not hire them, a maneuver that led players to ridicule it by saying, "What the heck?""That group championing diversity and equality isn't actually diverse or equal at all; who would have thought this was just a scam from start to finish?" That is exactly why I am glad. they lost their jobs. Overall, the closure of BioWare was not caused overnight, but rather the cumulative result of years of shifting development strategies, underwhelming performance, and the gradual erosion of player trust . While EA's decisions and the development environment have also impacted the studio's growth, for many players, what BioWare truly lost was its past ability to create unforgettable characters, stories, and gaming experiences. 傳奇工作室的誕生與黃金歲月

作者指出，BioWare 於 1995 年由三位擁有醫學背景的創辦人成立，他們憑藉對電腦遊戲的熱愛，以自研的「無限引擎」打造出《柏德之門》，成功挽救並確立了電腦角色扮演遊戲（CRPG）的地位。2007 年，藝電（EA）以約 8.6 億美元收購 BioWare 母公司。收購初期，BioWare 依舊展現出卓越的敘事功力，先後推出了宏大科幻的《質量效應》三部曲，以及贏得年度最佳遊戲、累積銷量突破 1200 萬套的《闇龍紀元：異端審判》。作者強調，BioWare 過去之所以深受愛戴，是因為其遊戲角色充滿血肉，且玩家的抉擇往往沒有標準答案，伴隨著不可逆的沉重代價與情感共鳴，甚至曾被專業心理治療師作為教學教材。

接二連三的開發危機與挫敗

然而隨著時間推移，BioWare 的作品品質開始滑坡。作者回顧，2017 年推出的《質量效應：仙女座》歷經反覆變更方向及轉用寒霜引擎的技術困境，大部分內容在最後 18 個月內倉促趕工，導致上市時充斥大量 Bug 與殭硬的臉部動畫，其中「我的臉很累」更成為玩家廣泛嘲諷的網路迷因，發售不到半年即停止更新單人模式。隨後，BioWare 轉戰服務型遊戲領域於 2019 年推出《冒險聖歌》，卻因內容匱乏、任務重複性過高與敘事殘缺慘遭滑鐵盧，即便曾承諾徹底重構遊戲，最終仍在玩家漫長等待後取消專案，並於 2024 年關閉伺服器。雖然 2021 年的《質量效應傳奇版》口碑極佳，但這僅是建立在過去的經典遺產之上。

摘要

遊戲裡無所不在的熟面孔

作者指出，近年遊戲玩家常在各種大型作品中看見同一張臉：演員兼配音員黛布拉·威爾森。她參與的遊戲已超過140款，除了配音，也經常負責動態捕捉，甚至直接以本人外貌呈現角色。從《星際大戰絕地：倖存者》、《德軍總部II》到《自殺突擊隊：戰勝正義聯盟》等作品，都能找到她的身影；她的高曝光度也讓玩家笑稱，似乎走到哪裡都會遇見她。

從《MADtv》到遊戲演出

在成為遊戲圈熟面孔以前，威爾森已因喜劇節目《MADtv》打開知名度。她是節目1995年開播時的八位原始班底之一，也是其中待得最久的成員，曾塑造多個鮮明角色，並以模仿歐普拉·溫芙蕾與惠妮·休斯頓等人的演出受到注意。2003年，她發現資歷較淺的白人男演員待遇更好，與製作方協商卻未獲回應，因而決定離開節目。此後她持續參與電視、電影、動畫與遊戲演出，展現從誇張喜劇到沉穩角色的多面性。

聲音演技為角色注入生命

雖然玩家常拿她的高出場率開玩笑，但不少人也肯定她的表演實力。作者以《天命2》中的謊言之神薩瓦森為例，指出威爾森將角色狡黠、嘲諷的語氣詮釋得令人印象深刻。粉絲甚至會透過 Cameo 請她用薩瓦森的聲音錄製鼓勵訊息，或替玩家公會開玩笑。她也曾在《天命2》告別影片中化身薩瓦森，以幽默又帶點感傷的方式向玩家道別，並鼓勵他們把遊戲中的勇氣帶到現實生活。

威爾森在不同作品中反覆現身，讓玩家開始戲稱她是遊戲界的「山繆·傑克森」，也有人把她在各款遊戲中的角色拼成迷因，笑問遊戲公司是不是把她的臉當成通用素材。2024年，創作者 DMY 問她哪家工作室最成功地還原自己的外貌，她選了《決勝時刻：現代戰爭》，認為角色模型的比例與光影都非常寫實，甚至能看見陽光映在睫毛上的細節。她高顴骨、深眼窩與標誌性的光頭造型，在臉部掃描技術加持下格外鮮明，也使部分玩家逐漸把某種強悍女性角色的視覺印象與她連結在一起。

威爾森回應角色外貌爭議

部分玩家將她頻繁出演不同作品，歸因於多元共融政策，甚至對她的外貌發動攻擊。對此，威爾森在訪談中坦言，自己也對某些安排感到挫折：她並不負責角色設計，角色外貌是遊戲公司與設計團隊決定的。她反而偏好外型與自己不同的角色，因為若角色總是長得像她，玩家便容易把演員本人與角色混為一談，也會限制角色的視覺想像與創作空間。她以《星際大戰絕地：隕落武士團》中的瑟蕾、《狼人：新秩序》中的葛蕾絲、《自殺突擊隊：戰勝正義聯盟》中的阿曼達·沃勒，以及即將推出的《漫威金鋼狼》角色卡利斯托為例，說明這些角色之所以像她，是製作團隊的選擇，而非她自己的決定。

作者最後指出，威爾森的高辨識度一方面來自她出色而多變的演出，另一方面也來自遊戲公司反覆採用她的外貌。玩家對她的熟悉感與調侃因此交織在一起；而威爾森的回應則提醒眾人，角色造型背後的決策並不由演員掌控，也值得把討論焦點放回遊戲設計本身。
